parts.title: Abduction servo cradle, left
parts.note: Print flange down. FL and RL share this part.

parts.title: Abduction servo cradle, right
parts.note: Mirror of the left cradle. FR and RR.

parts.title: Coxa link, left
parts.note: Print proximal flange down. Light supports under the arch.

parts.title: Spherical tread foot
parts.note: TPU 95A. 3 perimeters, 20% infill. Ball down if the slicer allows.

parts.title: 25T clamping horn
parts.note: Print flange down. 100% infill. Ream the bore to 6.1 only if the spline is tight — bore is modelled 6.1 mm.

parts.title: Standard digital servo
parts.note: IP-rated 25 kg·cm standard servo, 180° or 270° programmable. 12 leg + yaw + shoulder + elbow.

parts.title: Flight pack
parts.note: 2200 mAh ≥30C, XT30. Charge outside the robot.

parts.title: Computer
parts.note: Or any 65×30 class SBC. USB gadget for bench bring-up.

parts.title: Servo driver
parts.note: 16-channel servo PWM. Logic 5 V from the UBEC, servos on the pack.

parts.title: Regulator
parts.note: Logic rail only. Servo current does not pass through it.

parts.title: IMU
parts.note: Mount on the deck centreline, connectors aft.

parts.title: Camera
parts.note: 8 mm class lens, behind the hood.

parts.title: Ultrasonic
parts.note: Crop-height / obstacle ping. Optional on tall grass.

parts.title: Power switch
parts.note: Pack disconnect on the rear panel.

parts.title: M3×16 SHCS
parts.note: Flange stacks that include a horn.

parts.title: M3 nyloc nut
parts.note: Nyloc, inside the shell where a boss is not used.

parts.title: M3 heat-set insert
parts.note: Six deck bosses plus four yaw-clamp ears.
